subject: Control substantiation: exemplar packet delivery and scope clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Foster <elena.foster@peregrinefinancial.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Katherine Moss <katherine.moss@peregrinefinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exemplar artifact packet for SIG control substantiation

Mina —

Thanks for taking our SIG questionnaire — procurement wants to validate a few representative artifacts before we proceed to legal procurement. Specifically we need an exemplar packet that demonstrates:

- KMS key rotation evidence (sample logs, redacted)
- Telemetry/observability sample for request routing and latency traces (redacted traces, no PII)
- Control mapping spreadsheet that ties SIG control IDs to Redwood artifacts and owner names
- A short readme describing redaction approach and retention windows

Can you confirm what you can provide as a one-off exemplar (we understand production datasets are redacted) and an estimated delivery date?

Regards,
Elena Foster
Senior Procurement Manager
Peregrine Financial
elena.foster@peregrinefinancial.com

---
(Attachment: SIG_Request_Summary_11-01.pdf (pdf) referenced)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Foster <elena.foster@peregrinefinancial.com>
Cc: Katherine Moss <katherine.moss@peregrinefinancial.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exemplar artifact packet for SIG control substantiation

Elena —

We can provide an exemplar packet that addresses each of the items you listed. High level plan:

1) KMS key rotation: we'll provide a redacted change log showing key IDs (pseudonymized), timestamped rotations, and which service principal triggered the rotation. No material key material will be shared.

2) Telemetry sample: a 48-hour sample of anonymized traces illustrating request routing and latency breakdowns across hosted and private deployment paths (we will strip request payloads and token content). Format will be ndjson.

3) Control mapping: a CSV crosswalk that maps SIG control IDs to our control owner, artifact links, and evidence filenames.

4) Readme: a short document describing the redaction steps, retention policy, and any caveats for telemetry and KV cache samples.

We will compile these into a single exemplar packet and upload to a shared Drive link. Target delivery: end of day Friday, 3 Nov 2028 PT. If you need anything sooner for a procurement gating item, let us know which control IDs are highest priority and we will fast-track those.

Looping in Karthik and Irene for the artifact prep and redaction checklist.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Assurance Operations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
(Attachment: exemplar_artifact_index.csv (csv) referenced)

From: Elena Foster <elena.foster@peregrinefinancial.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Katherine Moss <katherine.moss@peregrinefinancial.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exemplar artifact packet for SIG control substantiation

Thanks Mina — that timeline works for the formal review. Two quick clarifications from our side before you prepare the full packet:

- For KMS rotation evidence, can you include the administrative audit trail entries that show who requested the rotation (roles only) and the rotation reason code? We need to validate separation of duties.

- For telemetry: we specifically want an example showing how a private deployment (VPC) request is routed and how key cache/KV cache is handled during inference. If you can label the sample traces to indicate host type (hosted vs dedicated vs private) that would be very helpful.

- Is it possible to supply an estimated retention period for the telemetry samples you produce for the exemplar (we're asking because our internal policy requires a retention bound in the artifact metadata).

If you can include a short line in the readme about how you pseudonymize principal IDs and how long the exemplar will be available in Drive before archival, that should be sufficient for procurement.

Appreciate it —
Elena

> On Wed, Nov 1, 2028 at 09:45 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> > We can provide an exemplar packet that addresses each of the items you listed. High level plan:
> > ...

(Attachment: procurement_priority_list.txt (txt) referenced)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Foster <elena.foster@peregrinefinancial.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Katherine Moss <katherine.moss@peregrinefinancial.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exemplar artifact packet for SIG control substantiation

Elena / Katherine —

Attached is the exemplar packet we prepared based on your asks. Summary of deliverables included in mina_exemplar_packet_v1.zip:

- redacted_kms_rotation_log.csv (admin audit trail rows, role-level actor column pseudonymized)
- telemetry-sample-20281101.ndjson (48-hour anonymized trace set; host_type field set to hosted/dedicated/private)
- control_mapping_crosswalk.csv (SIG ID -> Redwood artifact -> owner -> evidence filename)
- redaction_readme.txt (describes pseudonymization, retention: artifact will be available in shared Drive for 30 days, then moved to archive)
- exemplar_artifact_index.csv (index of filenames and short descriptions)

Notes / caveats:
- KMS logs show rotation events and administrative approvals; we have removed any literal key material and replaced principal IDs with role tags (e.g., "sec_admin_01").
- Telemetry sample includes synthetic request identifiers and no token content. KV cache and prefix-caching events are labeled; private deployment traces have host_type="private" and include routing hop timings but no network addresses.

Access: the packet is uploaded to the Drive folder shared in this thread. Download link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExemplarPacketsRedwood

If this satisfies procurement gating, we can generate a short attestation letter mapping the included artifacts to the SIG control IDs and sign it. If you prefer a call to walk through the packet, I'm available Monday 6 Nov 2028 between 10:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks — Karthik and Irene prepared the redaction and telemetry exports; copying them for any follow-up questions.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Assurance Operations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

(Attachments: telemetry-sample-20281101.ndjson (ndjson); mina_exemplar_packet_v1.zip (zip) )
